_comment: SH-040 — the arena manifest. Adding a level is an entry here plus the .world.json the editor writes; NO game code changes. Order is the order level-select shows.
_arena_01: Deliberately NOT listed. It is a pre-schema-v2 stub: 8 entities, no terrain block. The game reads terrain heights for physics, enemy ground-following and every scatter, so loading it would put the player and every alien at a NaN height. Offering a level that does not work is worse than offering one level. Rehab it in the editor (sculpt terrain, place a wave_config) and add it back.
